hook: Global Summit expo space to grow *2.6x* despite drought appeals
hook_b: Global Summit expo space to grow *2.6x* despite drought appeals
tldr: The government is going ahead with the Invest Telangana Global Summit 2026 at Bharat Future City on December 7-9, despite open letters from resident welfare associations, NRIs and a citizens' coalition asking for postponement.

beats.what: Plans include six expo hangars (one hall in 2025), 52 sector sessions and an advisory council of around 200 leaders from 25+ sectors.
beats.why: Opponents cite the El Nino water and power crisis; the government says the 2025 summit drew investment announcements of over $69 billion.
beats.care: Raksha Expo, an airshow and IndiaJoy 2026 are also part of the three-day event at Future City.

event.label: Bigger summit at Future City, Dec 7-9

effects.label: Groups seek postponement over water crisis

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The 2025 edition drew over 10,000 delegates and 500+ companies from 44+ countries, per the state.

cards.q: Should the Global Summit go ahead on Dec 7-9 or be postponed?

qs: How are investment announcements from 2025 tracked once the summit ends?
What does a drought declaration in 365 mandals change for residents?

facts.t: The state says the 2025 summit drew investment announcements worth *over $69 billion* and 75+ MoUs.
A citizens' coalition letter says drought and water crisis was declared in *365 mandals* across 31 districts.

viz.verdict: Bigger show for investors; critics question timing amid water crisis

watch: The summit runs December 7 to 9 at Bharat Future City; watch whether the government responds to the open letters.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Telangana Government presses ahead with Global Summit despite appeals for postponement

fact: Invest Telangana Global Summit's expo area jumps from *27,500* to *72,250 sq m*
twist: The state has declared a drought and water crisis in 365 mandals across 31 districts, the protest letter says.

learn.t: ITGS = Invest Telangana Global Summit, the state's annual investor meet
